Home / Featured Tools

SELECTED WITH A PURPOSE

Six tools. Six useful starting points.

A shortlist for distinct jobs, with the reasoning left in. These are documentation-based selections, not a performance ranking.

What earns a place?

Clear task fit, public technical evidence, understandable outputs, practical deployment information, and limitations a reader can check. Selection is editorial; placement is not sold.

Read the full selection policy →
Why this shortlist changed

Reviewed November 12, 2026. We considered task fit, public technical evidence, inspectable results, setup effort, and overlap. Lido adds spreadsheet-oriented operations; Atlas Workspace adds ready-to-use cited research answers.

PaddleOCR remains a candidate for a custom OCR stack; ColPali remains a candidate for building visual retrieval. Both stay in the directory. Their specialist roles are less direct starting points for this six-tool shortlist.

Explore PaddleOCR ↗ · Explore ColPali ↗

Choose Lido for spreadsheet workflows or LandingAI ADE for grounded extraction APIs. Choose Atlas Workspace for a research app or ColPali for a retrieval component. These are workflow distinctions, not measured quality rankings.

01 / Developer document conversion

Docling ↗

Its consistent document model is a useful entry point for teams converting mixed document formats before indexing or extraction.

What to verify

Inspect structured JSON for provenance; validate OCR configuration and export fidelity on difficult pages.

Official source ↗

Source review · 2026-11-12 · Not independently tested

02 / Grounded extraction APIs

LandingAI ADE ↗

Schema-defined extraction and source-grounded content make it worth evaluating when developers need fields that reviewers can inspect.

What to verify

Test field attribution and missing values. A commercial API may be unnecessary for a spreadsheet-only workflow.

Official source ↗

Source review · 2026-11-12 · Not independently tested

03 / Business spreadsheet workflows

Lido ↗

Document fields, spreadsheet outputs, validation, and downstream automation form a practical starting point for finance and operations teams.

What to verify

Validate line items and page allowances. Field-level page or coordinate export is not confirmed; no independent accuracy test is claimed.

Official source ↗

Source review · 2026-11-12 · Not independently tested

04 / Ready-to-use source-grounded Q&A

Atlas Workspace ↗

A research workspace combines source questions, cited passages, and maps, offering a direct route for readers who want to use document answers rather than build retrieval infrastructure.

What to verify

Check source and message limits and citation fidelity. This is not a drop-in retrieval API or an interoperable ontology editor.

Official source ↗

Source review · 2026-11-12 · Not independently tested

05 / Document-to-database research

DataMosaic ↗

DBMosaic combines target structures with extraction, verification, and repair; DocMosaic adds cross-page evidence investigation for long visual documents.

What to verify

Real processing requires deployment and configured models. The project site includes a static demo, and modules maintain separate workspaces.

Project site and demo ↗

Official source ↗

Source review · 2026-11-12 · Not independently tested

06 / Evolving semantics for data agents

EvoOntology ↗

An explicit build, use, evolve, and evaluate lifecycle provides a distinct starting point for studying how an agent ontology layer changes with workload evidence.

What to verify

This is a specialized semantic layer. Review the representation and evaluation design; it does not replace document parsing.

Official source ↗

Source review · 2026-11-12 · Not independently tested
